name: Cryonic-Terminus
description: Glacier upon glacier, blue-white and creaking, buried in places by nitrogen snow. The shell is broken in places by a nearby asteroid belt, and through those breaches the deep ocean breathes plumes of frost into the dark.
Standing still, you feel the frozen air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself.
Established during the last boom, the automated beacon of unknown purpose was never decommissioned. Its roster lists eleven souls; life-support draws power for thirty.
For traders, water alone justifies the crossing; for everyone else, the planet pays in questions. Fuel is cheap, information is not, and both are dangerous to carry.
